title: Aara
headline: A quieter kind of everyday ritual.
subtitle: A quieter kind of everyday ritual.
summary: A conceptual identity for an imagined Indian tea label, exploring stillness through refined serif typography, botanical illustration, earthy tones and coordinated packaging.
description: Aara imagines tea as a small everyday ritual. Its visual language balances deep green and warm parchment tones, expressive high-contrast typography and delicate botanical artwork across cartons, a tea tin and printed touchpoints.
status: Self-initiated concept, not commissioned client work
coverAlt: Aara tea brand concept display with green and ivory cartons, olive tea tin and stationery

visualLanguage.typography: High-contrast editorial serif paired with understated clean sans-serif
visualLanguage.botanicals: Delicate fine-line tea leaf and floral illustrations

touchpoints.title: Packaging Cartons
touchpoints.description: Dual-tone carton design: an ivory botanical variant and a forest-green companion box, creating an elevated presence on the counter.
